meta.name: competitive-teardown
meta.description: 定位图 + 功能矩阵 + 价格对比 + 机会窗口, 把竞品资料转成产品决策报告

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把竞品资料转成产品决策报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在做产品竞品分析或制定产品策略
copy.tagline_en: Turn competitor data into product decision reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are analyzing competitors or defining product strategy

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会根据你提供的竞品资料，生成一份包含定位图、功能矩阵、价格对比和机会窗口的结构化报告，帮助团队理解差距并制定下一步行动。
howto.when: 当你给出2到6个竞品的官网、定价、用户评论等资料，并请求进行竞品拆解时触发。如果只有一个竞品，会输出单竞品深度分析。

say.text: 帮我拆解这三个竞品的功能矩阵和价格策略。
say.note: Claude会生成包含功能对比和定价分析的报告。

say.text: 根据这些用户评价，找出竞品的机会窗口。
say.note: Claude会提取评价中的洞察并列出机会。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude transforms your competitive materials—like websites, pricing pages, and user reviews—into a structured report with positioning maps, feature matrices, pricing comparisons, and opportunity windows to help your team understand gaps and decide next moves.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide materials (e.g., websites, pricing, reviews) for 2–6 competitors and request a competitive teardown. With only one competitor, it outputs a deep dive.

say_en.text: Break down the feature matrix and pricing strategy for these three competitors.
say_en.note: Claude generates a report with feature comparison and pricing analysis.

say_en.text: Find opportunity windows from these user reviews.
say_en.note: Claude extracts insights and lists opportunities from the reviews.
